integrity: The independent computational checks and the complete nine-symbol local proof certificate are documented and replayable; no external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact count of minimum Italian dominating functions for ordinary two-row ladders only; not a full polynomial or extension to wider grids. The 2018 ladder thesis was inspected through its abstract and search-indexed Theorem 3.4 excerpt, not its inaccessible complete PDF. Equivalent unindexed work remains possible.
title: Exact minimum Italian-domination counts and a three-tile classification on ladders
